environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) with IMDSv2 required (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1). Additionally, the process runs under a custom SELinux policy module 'enrichment_svc_t' compiled with type enforcement rules that restrict network connect permissions to only port 443 on labeled backend_endpoint_t nodes (via semanage port mappings for 10.0.0.0/8 range on port 8443 and 443). The policy includes a 'corenet_tcp_connect_http_port' denial for the 169.254.169.254 link-local range mapped as imds_port_t, and file read access is confined to /etc/app/** and /usr/lib/** only. The policy was generated via audit2allow from a 2-week production trace and then manually hardened to remove net_raw and sys_admin capabilities. Instance metadata service responses require a session token (PUT /latest/api/token with X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header) which cannot be obtained through the SSRF because the hop-limit=1 prevents the token PUT request from succeeding when proxied through the application layer.

config.selinux_te_rules: allow enrichment_svc_t backend_endpoint_t:tcp_socket { name_connect }; deny enrichment_svc_t imds_port_t:tcp_socket { name_connect };
